# Polynomial Regression – Salary Prediction

A simple Machine Learning project that predicts salary based on years of experience using Polynomial Regression.

## Overview

This project explores the relationship between years of experience and salary using Polynomial Regression.

## Dataset

- **Feature:** YearsExperience
- **Target:** Salary
- **Samples:** 20
- **Dataset:** Synthetic dataset

## Technologies

- Python
- NumPy
- Pandas
- Matplotlib
- Scikit-learn
- Joblib

## Concepts Covered

- Polynomial Regression
- Polynomial Features
- Linear vs Polynomial Regression
- Polynomial Degree Selection
- Underfitting and Overfitting
- Model Evaluation (MAE, MSE, RMSE, R²)
- Model Saving and Loading

## Implementation

- Linear Regression baseline
- Polynomial Regression using Scikit-learn
- Comparison of polynomial degrees (1–5)
- Custom salary prediction

## Goal

To understand how Polynomial Regression works and how it captures nonlinear relationships between variables.
